cold_open: Jared Goff scored 30.89 on Shawn's bench, Patrick Mahomes 26.49 on Kevin Swanson's, Bryce Young 24.04 on Douglas's. Shawn and Swanson posted the week's two highest scores anyway. Douglas posted its lowest.

notes.Shawn|Thomas: Shawn's 107.33 topped the league and would have beaten all eleven teams, with Goff's 30.89 never leaving the bench. He snapped Tom's two-game run and leads the series 21–18.
notes.Evan|Steve Swanson: The week's narrowest game, 96.04–94.31. Evan started the quarterback of the week, Josh Allen at 38.41, and lost anyway: Isaiah Likely's 4.15 sat behind DJ Moore's −0.05. Evan leads 16–15.
notes.Jeff|Kevin O'Boyle: Decided by 2.29. Jeff had George Kittle's 12.0 on his bench behind Rhamondre Stevenson's 0.8, and that one swap wins it. O'Boyle has won two straight and leads 9–5.
notes.Brian Clark|Eric: Clark won by 40.92 and still left 26.81 on his bench, the Vikings' 17 among it. He has won three of their seven meetings; Eric leads the young series 4–3.
notes.Douglas|Fadi: The luckiest win: Fadi's 66.73 was ninth-best. Doug's best possible lineup scored 81.44, with Bryce Young's 24.04 benched behind Jayden Daniels's 11.37. Fadi has won three straight and leads 15–5.
notes.Dominic|Kevin Swanson: The week's biggest blowout, by 47.24. Swanson beat his projection by 29.97, with Jaxon Smith-Njigba's 30.25 and the Patriots' 21. Dominic's Jaxson Dart scored 0.4 on a 14.7 projection.

kicker: Jeff left George Kittle on his bench and lost by 2.29. Dominic, whose team is named for the man, lost by 47.24.
